title: Signal and structure agree
description: On 9 Apr 2023 18:00 the close of 28,044 breaks above the last lower high: a bullish market structure break. The very next candle is a bullish break of structure (28,165), so the signal and the structure agree within an hour. Three more breaks take price to 29.6k. A second bullish market structure break follows on 10 Apr 15:00 (28,459), above the bounce high of the next downswing. The snippet ends at its high, so at level 1 it is one upleg holding only upswings; the downswings, and so these breaks, are at level 2.
